description: Land Title Settlement Department - Parawahera, Matara D/S Division, Matara District  (24/0753)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and property ownership matters. It contains declarations of title determination for specific land parcels, including owner names, parcel numbers, extents, and legal details related to land registration under the Registration of Title Act. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership, and land title settlements.
